scope: Read-only integrity check of frozen Q1/Q2 run artifacts, local source, runtime ledger, nearby local test logs, and the completed two-pass Q2 AI review. AI review is not human or learner validation.

archive_integrity.source_hash_coverage: Manifest-listed Python files under app/ and three experiment scripts; frontend assets, tests, and dependencies are outside this code snapshot.

q1_q2_controls.interpretation: The recorded protocol controls match. Changed source files define the Q2 intervention; one serial run and uncontrolled host load do not establish causal latency gains.

runtime_and_ledger.failure_classification: Rerank provider HTTP 503; run/job records and ledger agree. No automatic retry is recorded for this case.
runtime_and_ledger.usage_boundary: One failed call has no total-token record; provider-reported cost is partial, with totals null in the summary.

mocked_backend_preliminary.note: Earlier local run failed; the later complete backend run passed.

test_logs.provenance_limit: The logs are local /private/tmp files outside the frozen Q2 directory and are not hashed by its manifest. Their exact tested source revision cannot be independently proven from the run archive alone.

credential_value_scan.scope: Q2 run directory recursively (including four sealed AI batches and final summary), final comparison directory, and Q2 report; validation.json excluded.
credential_value_scan.method: Heuristic token/private-key signatures and literal named credential assignments; no matched values or paths recorded.
credential_value_scan.boundary: Pattern scan only; not proof that no credentials exist.

summary_usability.comparison: Q1 delivered 20/24 and strict 15/24; Q2 delivered 23/24 and strict 18/24. These are descriptive internal run metrics.
summary_usability.quality_boundary: Q2 two-pass Codex AI review is sealed: 23/23 delivered candidates reviewed, 14/23 core quality pass, 13/23 target-difficulty match. It remains AI-assisted review, not teacher/human adjudication or learner outcome evidence.
summary_usability.latency_boundary: Wall-time comparisons are descriptive because host background load was not controlled and the mocked backend suite overlapped early Q2 work.

ai_review_validation.evidence_tier: Two-pass masked Codex AI-assisted review. No human or learner validation.
ai_review_validation.boundary: One Codex AI rater per candidate; the summary is not teacher adjudication, inter-rater agreement, or learner outcome evidence.

report_validation.boundary: This checks report links and signatures plus read-only recomputation; it does not establish educational correctness.
